The finance department completed the quarterly review in October. The team found no errors in the submitted expense reports. All department heads filed accurate and complete documentation on time.

The IT department recommends replacing the legacy accounting software. Senior management approved the budget for the upgrade. The team will complete the migration by end of Q1.

HR will run training sessions for all staff before the migration date. Each session covers the key features of the new system. All staff must attend one session to prepare for the change.
